name: Backend Architecture & Design Patterns
description: Architectural paradigms and software design patterns for scalable backend systems: Layered architecture, Dependency Injection, Gang of Four (GoF) behavioral/structural design patterns, Clean/Hexagonal Architecture (Ports and Adapters), Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Microservices decomposition, Event-Driven Architecture (EDA), Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS), Event Sourcing, and Service Mesh.

subskills.name: Layered Architecture
subskills.description: Controller-Service-Repository separation of concerns, data transfer objects (DTOs), business logic isolation from web/persistence frameworks.

subskills.name: Dependency Injection & Inversion
subskills.description: Dependency Inversion Principle (DIP), Inversion of Control (IoC) containers (Spring IoC, NestJS DI, Dagger), and constructor injection.

subskills.name: Backend Design Patterns (GoF)
subskills.description: Factory, Strategy, Adapter, Decorator, Observer, and Chain of Responsibility patterns applied to backend workflows.

subskills.name: Clean & Hexagonal Architecture
subskills.description: Ports and Adapters, Onion architecture, pure domain entities, use case interactor classes, and framework-independent business rules.

subskills.name: Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
subskills.description: Strategic and tactical DDD: Bounded Contexts, Ubiquitous Language, Aggregates, Entities, Value Objects, Domain Services, and Domain Events.

subskills.name: Microservices Decomposition
subskills.description: Decomposition by subdomain or business capability, database-per-service pattern, synchronous vs asynchronous inter-service communication.

subskills.name: Event-Driven Architecture (EDA)
subskills.description: Event choreography vs orchestration, domain events, asynchronous event publishing, consumer decouplings, and event schema governance.

subskills.name: CQRS Pattern
subskills.description: Command Query Responsibility Segregation, asymmetric read and write data models, and specialized projection pipelines.

subskills.name: Event Sourcing
subskills.description: Append-only immutable event store, state reconstruction by event replaying, snapshotting mechanisms, and auditability.

subskills.name: Service Mesh & Sidecars
subskills.description: Istio, Envoy sidecar proxies, mutual TLS (mTLS) zero-trust communication, traffic splitting (canary releases), and distributed resilience.

junior.description: Applies controller-service-repository layered patterns, uses dependency injection containers, and implements standard GoF design patterns.

mid.description: Implements Hexagonal / Ports and Adapters architecture, models tactical DDD aggregates, and designs microservice and event-driven communication flows.

senior.description: Architects asynchronous CQRS read/write pipelines, designs append-only Event Sourced systems with snapshotting, and manages Service Mesh mTLS routing.
